Open the deck in a tab of its own while the facilitator talks, so that R loads in it. When the slides ask for your estimand statement, which is Task 2, write it in the chat, hold it, and send it when the facilitator says go.

## Task 1 – The setup check

**In the deck.** Wait for the R engine, run the setup cell, and check that `housing` has 1,014 rows and that the last line reports −19.97 percentage points. Then work through the warm-up on the three Rs, on the next slide.

[Open the deck at Task 1](../../live/short.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If the deck does not load, run the same cells in the browser lab, which gives the same numbers.

## Task 3 – The reproduction

**In the deck.** Run the cell that reads the public file `housing_original.csv`, choose one of the five analysts and work through the cells of that analyst. Type the analyst and your value in the chat without sending them, and send them when the facilitator says go.

[Open the deck at Task 3](../../live/short.html#/hands-on-3-reproduce-the-recorded-result){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 3](../../lab.qmd#task-3-reproduction){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
